source.title: The First Step
source.description:
In Caldoran's hubris, he thought that he could force the blade to submit to his will. He stole the lives of his most fervently loyal followers to fuel his attempt to dominate the blade. What he didn't realize is that this power can't be taken by force; its cleansing must be earned.

Speak with me further if you wish to see the blade restored. If you are strong enough, you might just succeed.
source.progress: <The spectral outline of the Will of the Ashbringer shifts and shivers in an unsettling way.>
source.completion:
So now you see? You must see this through until the end, and that end is far from certain. If you would see this task completed, then you must have courage even in the face of that uncertainty.

Do you have that courage?
